title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Says Judge Not
caption:
"Judge not" gets used to shut down every hard conversation. Read the rest of the passage and it's actually the opposite.

It's an order to deal with your own log before you go looking for his speck. Hard on yourself first. Gentle with him after.

Most men run that backward: sharp with everyone else, soft on their own excuses. Flip it back and watch what happens to your friendships.

The measure you use gets measured back to you.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #scripture #humility
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
